**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant. Trigger-term searches ("solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "employ or engage", "personnel", "employee") surface only unrelated provisions — "solicited input" in the governance/committee mechanics, the FTE definition, confidentiality recipients, the no-debarment and inventor-assignment covenants, and indemnitee party lists. The covenant blocks (Sections 13.3 RevMed Covenants and 13.4 Mutual Covenants) and the General Provisions article are both free of any hiring restriction.

This matches the playbook's **preferred** position — no non-solicit binding the Customer — so Sanofi remains free to solicit or hire RevMed personnel. Since the absence operates in our favour, no "missing" finding or redline is appropriate.
